description: Games View UX Improvements - Increase information density by replacing card-based layout with compact table-style rows. Reference patterns from Caesars, FanDuel, DraftKings sportsbook apps.

userStories.title: Replace GameCardView with CompactGameRow
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see more games on screen so I can quickly scan available betting options.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new CompactGameRow.swift component in Booki/Views/
Row height reduced to ~80-90pt (from ~140pt cards)
No card shadows, gradient borders, or decorative overlays
Use Theme.cardBackground with single 0.5pt Theme.border bottom divider
Accept same parameters as GameCardView: event, selections, onSelectOdds, onTapCard, lockOffsetMinutes
Selection state (highlight when odds added to slip) still works
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Typecheck requires Xcode IDE verification per CLAUDE.md

userStories.title: Implement Table-Style Odds Layout
userStories.description: As a player, I want odds displayed in aligned columns so I can quickly compare spreads, moneylines, and totals across games.
acceptanceCriteria: Odds buttons sized at 52x44pt (reduced from 60x60pt)
Away team row: Team name | Spread | ML | Total
Home team row: Team name | Spread | ML | Total
Buttons display spread/total value and odds on single line (e.g. '-3.5 -110')
Use HStack with fixed-width columns for alignment
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented as part of US-001 - CompactGameRow already includes table-style layout

userStories.title: Compact Team Name Display
userStories.description: As a player, I want team names displayed clearly without excessive spacing.
acceptanceCriteria: Team name uses .system(size: 13, weight: .semibold)
Team name row height is 36pt total
Team names left-aligned, truncated with ellipsis if needed
lineLimit(1) applied to team names
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented as part of US-001 - CompactGameRow already has compact team name styling

userStories.title: Simplified Game Time Display
userStories.description: As a player, I want game time shown compactly.
acceptanceCriteria: Game time shown as single line above the matchup: 'Today 7:00 PM' or 'Sat, Jan 25'
Font size .caption2 (11pt) with Theme.textSecondary color
Remove clock icon to save horizontal space
Live indicator reduced to small 'LIVE' text badge without pulsing animation
Lock icon shows inline when event is locked
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented as part of US-001 - CompactGameRow timeHeader already has simplified styling

userStories.title: Streamlined Odds Buttons
userStories.description: As a player, I want odds buttons that are easy to tap but don't waste space with excessive styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Create CompactOddsButton component replacing SpreadButton, MLButton, TotalButton
Odds button background: Theme.elevatedBackground (unselected) or Theme.accent (selected)
No gradient backgrounds - solid colors only
No outer glow/shadow effects
Border: 1pt Theme.border (unselected) or Theme.accent (selected)
Corner radius: 6pt
Maintain spring animation on tap but remove selection highlight radial gradient
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented as compactOddsButton method in CompactGameRow - may need extraction for US-011 reuse

userStories.title: Sticky Column Headers
userStories.description: As a player, I want the SPREAD/MONEY/TOTAL column headers to stay visible while scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Column headers row sticks below sport tabs when scrolling
Headers use .system(size: 10, weight: .semibold) with Theme.textMuted
Headers row has Theme.background background
0.5pt bottom border using Theme.divider
Use LazyVStack(pinnedViews: [.sectionHeaders]) for sticky behavior
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added columnHeadersRow with LazyVStack pinnedViews in GamesView

userStories.title: Sport Section Headers Inline
userStories.description: As a player, I want sport/league headers to be compact.
acceptanceCriteria: Section header format: 'NBA • Eastern Conference' in single line
Font: .system(size: 12, weight: .medium) with Theme.textSecondary
Top padding 16pt, bottom padding 8pt
No background color - just text
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in sportSection alongside US-006 sticky headers

userStories.title: Update GamesView to Use Compact Rows
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to update GamesView to use the new compact row component.
acceptanceCriteria: GamesView uses CompactGameRow instead of GameCardView
LazyVStack spacing reduced to 0 (dividers handle separation)
Horizontal padding reduced to 12pt (from 16pt)
Favorites section uses same compact row style
All existing functionality preserved: search, sport tabs, favorites, bet slip
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Replaced GameCardView with CompactGameRow in GamesView

userStories.title: Clean Up Legacy Components
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove unused components to keep codebase clean.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove or deprecate SpreadButton, MLButton, TotalButton from GameCardView.swift
Keep GameCardView.swift for potential future use but mark as legacy
Keep BetSlipSelection model unchanged
Keep OddsButton for use in MarketSelectionView
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Marked legacy components with deprecation comments

userStories.title: Create Game Detail View
userStories.description: As a player, I want to tap into a game and see all available betting markets so I can explore more options.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GameDetailView.swift in Booki/Views/ (replaces MarketSelectionView for players)
Game header shows: Away team vs Home team, game time, live status if applicable
Header uses Theme.cardBackground with team names in .title3 weight
Display game time in format 'Today 7:00 PM' or 'Sat, Jan 25 • 1:00 PM'
Tapping game row in GamesView navigates to GameDetailView
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Game Detail Main Markets Section
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see the main betting markets prominently displayed at the top of the game detail page.
acceptanceCriteria: Main Lines section displays spread, moneyline, and total markets
Each market shows both sides in a horizontal row using CompactOddsButton
Tapping an odds button adds selection to bet slip via BetSlipManager
Selected state highlights with Theme.accent
Section header uses .system(size: 14, weight: .semibold) with Theme.textPrimary
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Game Detail Market Categories
userStories.description: As a player, I want to browse different market categories so I can find specific bets.
acceptanceCriteria: Horizontal scrolling category tabs below main markets
Categories: All Markets, Alternate Lines, Player Props, Game Props
Tab style matches sport tabs in GamesView (capsule buttons)
All Markets selected by default, shows all available markets grouped by type
Each category filters the displayed markets below
Empty state shown if category has no markets
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Game Detail Market List
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see all markets for the selected category in a scannable list.
acceptanceCriteria: Markets grouped by type with section headers (Spread, Total, Moneyline)
Each market row shows both sides with odds buttons
For alternate lines: show line value prominently (e.g. 'Alt Spread -5.5')
Use same compact styling as main games list (no decorative cards)
Scrollable list with Theme.background
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Game Detail Bet Slip Integration
userStories.description: As a player, I want selections from the game detail page to appear in my bet slip.
acceptanceCriteria: Selections made in GameDetailView add to BetSlipManager
Floating bet slip indicator appears at bottom (same as GamesView)
Tapping indicator opens BetSlipSheet
Multiple selections from same game allowed (for parlays)
Navigating back to GamesView preserves bet slip selections
Typecheck passes
